product.name: Pushary
product.tagline: Control panel for AI agents on your lock screen
product.description: Your AI agents stop when they need a permission or an answer. Pushary puts that yes or no on your lock screen, so the work keeps moving while you are away. New in this launch: native iPhone and Android apps. Pair with your terminal by scanning a QR code, no key to paste. Approvals, questions, and task-done alerts from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Hermes, and Claude Cowork land in one inbox, with per-tool policies that auto-approve the safe stuff and an audit trail of every decision.
